control_points_note: No control points: no architectural plane is visible in both images. The photo shows the north end (buildings behind the Péristyle de Beaujolais), which is behind the lithograph's viewpoint; the lithograph's subject (Galerie d'Orléans colonnade and the palace) is behind the photographer. Side facades (galeries de Valois / Montpensier) are hidden by the lime alleys in the photo.

observations: Same place (Jardin du Palais-Royal, Paris 1er), confirmed by the LoC subject headings and by the photo location inside the garden polygon.
Opposite viewing direction: lithograph looks SSW towards the Galerie d'Orléans and the palace; the photo (azimuth 20°) looks NNE towards rue de Beaujolais.
Lithograph is drawn from an elevated point above the north end; the photo is at ground level among trees.
Therefore no homography is attempted; the viewer shows both originals side by side.
